label: Law fork under the contingent-fact PSR, applied alike to laws and adoptions
description: The contingent-fact PSR asks for a reason for a law's obtaining exactly when the law varies across accessible worlds, and asks the same of a selector's adoption of that law: the demand is symmetric between impersonal law and personal selection. A law or adoption that is constant across accessible worlds escapes it. An admitted reason need not fix the law. A fact-PSR application, not the existence-PSR bridge 608a262d. Establishes no premise, no contingency of any actual law and no identification of reasons with intentional exercise; connection plan to 66aecdd7. Not a transcription.
